descriptionChirho: The proper noun לוּז (Luz), a Canaanite city later renamed Bethel (Genesis 28:19), also a city built by a man from the original Luz (Judges 1:26). All four clusters represent the same toponym with variation only in prepositional framing and directional suffix: absolute (Luz), with ה-locale suffix (Luzah, 'toward Luz'), with preposition ב (in Luz), and construct with directional sense (Luz-ward). Arabic uses لُوز (Lūz), Korean uses 루스/루즈 (Ruseu/Rujeu), Hindi uses लूज़ (Lūz), Swahili uses Luzu/Luzi/Luza/Lusa, and Spanish uses Luz consistently. These are grammatical variants of a single place name.
